title: A practical mending afternoon
passage:
Thanks for coming to our mending afternoon. If a bag has a torn handle, take a strip that reaches well beyond the tear. It can go inside or outside. Only the long strips reach that far. They’re yellow; the shorter strips match Sam’s bag. He’s turning it into a gift. He doesn’t mind the mark already on the front, but asked us not to make one handle stand out. If you didn’t bring a bag, take a practice pouch from the crate. It’s yours to keep, but leave the clips for the next group. 

One more thing for the photo record. Last week the pouch was lying flat, so the loose seam looked as if it was closed. Once we slid a card inside, the pouch took the shape it has in use, and we could see the gap. We’ll take one picture now and one after mending. By the end of the session the seat by the window will be in the shade. The lamp on the workbench stays the same.
passageZh:
謝謝大家來參加下午的修補活動。若要補破掉的袋子提把，請拿一條能伸過破口兩端一大截的布條。布條可以補在內側，也可以補在外側。只有長布條夠長，全是黃色；短布條的顏色才和山姆的袋子一樣。他要把這個袋子當禮物。正面的舊痕跡他不在意，但請我們別讓其中一個提把特別顯眼。沒帶袋子的人，可以從箱子拿一個練習用小袋。小袋可以帶回去，但夾子要留給下一組。

拍照紀錄也提醒一件事。上週有條鬆開的接縫看似合上了，因為小袋是平放的。把一張卡片滑進去，讓小袋撐成使用時的樣子，才看得見開口。現在先拍一張，補完後再拍一張。活動結束時，窗邊會變成陰影，工作台的燈則保持不變。
